item.title: St. Joseph County Council updates residents on Affordability Agenda
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- The St. Joseph County Council, along with Republican State Senator Linda Rogers, gave an update Monday on an Affordability Agenda that was unveiled in January.

item.title: Friends and family celebrate life of Jamecia Moffitt
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- A little more than three weeks ago, Jamecia Moffitt was beaten to death on February 28. Dewayne Shurn is charged with one count of murder, and a habitual offender enhancement. Monday night, family, friends, and loved ones paid tribute to Jamecia.

item.title: SB Common Council adopts Downtown 2045 Plan
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Common Council unanimously adopted the Downtown 2045 Plan Monday evening.

item.title: Goshen City Council amends DORA rules amid community concerns
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- The Goshen City Council is amending its Designated Outdoor Refreshment Area (DORA) ordinance after concerns were raised by residents about safety and community impact.

item.title: Top Senate Republicans coalesce behind plan to end DHS shutdown
item.description: (CNN) — Top Senate Republicans on Capitol Hill believe their party is unified behind a plan to reopen the Department of Homeland Security. Now, they need to sell the plan to Democrats.

item.title: ‘Please do something’: Concerns raised about LaGuardia safety before fatal runway collision
item.description: (CNN) — Pilots have raised concerns about miscommunication, air traffic control missteps and other hazards at LaGuardia Airport, according to a CNN review of government records for the past two years.

item.title: Markwayne Mullin confirmed to lead a DHS in turmoil
item.description: (CNN) — Markwayne Mullin will serve as Donald Trump’s next Department of Homeland Security secretary, elevating the US senator to helm the agency at the center of the president’s controversial immigration enforcement effort and an ongoing shutdown.

item.title: Staying sunny until Thursday
item.description: The ridge of high pressure moving over the Great Lakes will help bring in warmer and generally sunnier weather today and tomorrow. Temperatures reach the low 50s this afternoon, drop into the mid 30s tonight,

item.title: Four arrested after alleged dark web drug purchases
item.description: ROCHESTER, Ind. -- On Tuesday, the Fulton County Sheriff's Office announced four arrests following a narcotics investigation, including one 18-year-old who allegedly purchased narcotics through the dark web.

item.title: All Nations Church hosts March Gladness family event
item.description: BERRIEN COUNTY, Mich. -- All Nations Seventh-day Adventist Church is hosting a free "March Gladness" event on Saturday in Berrien Springs, featuring family games and a basketball tournament.
